sections.title: Advanced Clinical Concepts and Professional Role for Critical Care Advanced Practice Providers II
sections.description: This is the second of two courses specifically designed for Advanced Practice Providers enrolled in the Penn Medicine Critical Care Advanced Practitioner Fellowship Program. This course continues to examine the knowledge, skills and professional behaviors required to deliver safe, quality care that meets defined standards of practice. Core competencies to provide evidence-based, cost effective care expected of Advanced Practice Providers in an intensivist-led, multiprofessional critical care team are further developed and honed. Strategies to synthesize and integrate these knowledge, skills and attitudes into the fellow’s practice are constructed and demonstrated.
